_source: IPCC AR6 WG1 Ch. 7 metrics (Forster et al. 2021, Section 7.6 and 7.SM.5; Table 7.SM.7), parameters as in the AR6 metric code https://github.com/chrisroadmap/ar6 (commit 24f279260fc2d1ebd09b2bd4114f2be11859e925). Generated by dev/build_ar6_data.py; do not edit by hand.

constants._source: src/ar6/metrics/constants.py (molar masses in kg/mol, atmosphere mass in kg)

temperature_response._source: notebook 335 (AR6 two-layer emulator; 7.SM.5.2): R_T(t) = sum q_j/d_j exp(-t/d_j)

co2._source: co2.py and notebook 335: Meinshausen 2020 ERF of +1 ppm, x1.05 adjustment; Joos et al. 2013 impulse response

ch4._source: ch4.py and notebook 335; oxidation: AR6 Eq. 7.SM.5.8 and Section 7.6.1.3
ch4._radiative_efficiency_direct: Meinshausen 2020 SARF x (1 + tropospheric_adjustment); a scenario-dependent SARF gets the same adjustment

n2o._source: n2o.py and notebook 335 (CH4 destruction from AR5 8.SM.11.3.3)

halocarbons._source: notebook 335, cell 24: lifetimes, radiative efficiencies and molar masses from hodnebrog20.csv (Hodnebrog et al. 2020, identical to the file in the AR6 code); +12 % tropospheric adjustment for CFC-11 and CFC-12

2551-62-4._source: SF6: AR6 Table 7.15 (GWP100 24 300, as in the static IPCC 2021 methods) uses a lifetime of 1000 yr; Table 7.SM.7 keeps the Hodnebrog et al. 2020 value of 3200 yr (GWP100 25 200)

climate_carbon_feedback._source: Gasser et al. 2017, Table 1 (AR6 Table 7.SM.6 uses the mean row); upper/lower = +-1 SD rows
